newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING PREFERS BANK ACQUISITION TO INSURER.
newsitem.headline: ING PREFERS BANK ACQUISITION TO INSURER.

text.p: Dutch banking and insurance group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it would prefer a bank to an insurer as a possible acquisition candidate.
"A bank is more interesting for us because it would be a better fit strategically," ING chairman Aad Jacobs told a news conference on the group's 1996 results.
Jacobs said ING would give priority to expansion in Europe, adding that ING would seriously consider forming an alliance with another major financial group if the opportunity arose.
Jacobs reiterated the bank's stake in Belgian Banque Bruxelles Lambert was not for sale.
There has been renewed speculation this year about the formation of a Big Belgian Bank by merging BBL with Generale Bank, Belgium's biggest lender.
"I believe this is a very interesting investment," Jacobs said.
